subject: Recap & pilot proposal — next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@finovate.io>, Alexandra Gomes <alex.gomes@finovate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & pilot proposal — next steps

Sam / Alex — thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and a proposed, lightweight path to prove value: 

Summary of needs (from our call)
- Low-latency inference for chat features (95th pct < 300ms)
- Cost predictability for peak trading windows
- Audit logs + per-request retention controls for compliance

Proposed pilot (6 weeks) — goal: validate latency & cost at production-like traffic
- Week 0: kickoff + access + test vectors
- Weeks 1–3: integration (prefix caching + routing) + baseline metrics
- Weeks 4–5: scale tests + quality checks
- Week 6: recommendations and handoff (quantization profile + cost plan)

Deliverables
- Pilot SOW & runbook
- Performance report (latency/cost/accuracy)
- Ops playbook for production rollout

As discussed, attaching a short proposal and a resourcing sheet so you can see the people/time estimate. If this approach looks reasonable, next steps I suggest: 
1) Confirm the internal decision-maker(s) we should be coordinating with (legal/procurement/infra).
2) I’ll share a one-page SOW and non-prod access details for your engineering team to review.
3) Tentative start: any time in late April / early May (we can shift to fit your calendar).

Attachments: redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf, pilot-resourcing-sheet.xlsx

If you want, I can schedule a 15-min sync for next week to walk Alex/your infra folks through integration touchpoints.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Redwood Inference — High-performance inference, production-ready
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@finovate.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexandra Gomes <alex.gomes@finovate.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & pilot proposal — next steps

Hey Karthik — thanks for the clear recap and the materials. I ran this by Alex and our platform team this morning. A few things we need clarified before we can greenlight a pilot: 

- Data residency: can logs and KV cache be scoped to our US region and archived on our own S3?
- Integration effort: what level of code changes are needed for our request path (we prefer adapters over full rework) — can you share typical integration time for a team like ours?
- Cost caps: we'd like a clear monthly not-to-exceed estimate for a pilot-sized pool.

We'll loop in procurement/legal for an SOW review but I need the answers above to make the ask. I'll try to get a short window with our infra lead next week — if we can address these 3 points quickly, I think we can move forward.

Also tagging Alexandra in case she has additions.

Best,
Sam Carter
CTO, Finovate Systems
sam.carter@finovate.io
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@finovate.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alexandra Gomes <alex.gomes@finovate.io>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & pilot proposal — next steps

Sam — just bumping this thread in case it got buried. Quick answers inline below and attached a one-page SOW for procurement: 

- Data residency: yes — logs and KV/cache can be configured to your US S3 bucket and we support customer-managed S3 for retention; we can also redact tokens at the ingestion step.
- Integration effort: most customers integrate with a small adapter (1–2 devs, ~2 weeks) to route requests; we'll provide example code and a sandbox token.
- Cost caps: attached pilot SOW includes an optional not-to-exceed cap for the pilot. If you prefer, we can set an explicit monthly cap in the pilot config.

I re-attached the proposal (redwood-pilot-proposal.pdf) and a resourcing sheet that shows typical timelines.

Would you like to schedule a 20-min call with our infra lead (Marissa) this week to walk through the integration model? If this is still something you want to explore for Q2, happy to prioritize dates.

Thanks —
Karthik

1) If this is still timely for Finovate, I can book a 15–20 min call with Marissa (our infra lead) and your platform owner to run through the integration and cost cap language — we can lock a pilot start window in minutes.
